name: Immer
overview: The name Immer appears in Scripture primarily associated with a family of priests, as evidenced by the references to the 'children of Immer' numbering over a thousand (Ezra 2:37; Nehemiah 7:40). Immer is also identified as the father of notable priestly figures such as Zadok, who took part in rebuilding efforts (Nehemiah 3:29), and Pashur, indicating a leadership role within priestly divisions. Additionally, the name is linked to a group of people who returned from exile but could not establish their precise genealogical heritage (Ezra 2:59; Nehemiah 7:61), highlighting the challenges of maintaining priestly lineage post-exile.
